名称.value: 按股利收益率分组的组合

市场.value: 美国股票（NYSE、AMEX、NASDAQ；断点仅用 NYSE）

标题.value: 按股利收益率分组的组合

规则.value: 已打开详情页原文：Detail for Portfolios Formed on Dividend Yield Detail for Portfolios Formed on Dividend Yield Monthly Returns: July 1927- July 2026 Annual Returns: 1928-2025 Portfolios: Dividends = 0; bottom 30%, middle 40%, top 30%; quintiles; deciles. Firms with zero dividends are in only the Dividends = 0 portfolio. Construction: Portfolios are formed on D/P at the end of each June using NYSE breakpoints. The dividend yield use to form portfolios in June of year t is the total dividends paid from July of t-1 to June of t per dollar of equity in June of t. Stocks: All NYSE, AMEX, and NASDAQ stocks for which we have ME for June of year t, and at least 7 monthly returns (to compute the dividend yield) from July of t-1 to June of t.
